Interface ObjectiveType

public interface ObjectiveType
A kind of goal: "Mine blocks", "Defeat mobs", or one another mod added with QuestsAPI.registerObjective(String, String, String, String, boolean, String). Admins pick it in the editor (/quests, Edit tab).
